name: Dexter Morgan's apartment
summary: A Washington Island apartment block built to match the home of TV's Dexter Morgan, with a lookalike boat docked nearby.
body: GameSpot says Dexter Morgan's apartment from the Dexter TV series is recreated in Vice City, and that fans first noticed it in pre-launch gameplay footage.

GameSpot places it on Washington Island in eastern Vice City, between the Pay 'N' Spray and the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons, as a small light blue building with a cylinder-shaped stairwell on its south side.
According to GameSpot, the apartment is the corner unit at the west end of the second-floor outdoor walkway, reached by those stairs, with a view of the water.

GameSpot says the door is locked and it found no Dexter objects nearby; the only possible nod it found is a centre-console boat at the docks west of the building that resembles Dexter's Slice of Life, though it does not carry that name.
Dexerto and TheGamer both report that the game calls the complex "Trinity Apartments", which they read as a nod to the Trinity Killer from the show.

Dexerto says the apartment door can be reached but not opened; both sites say the roof holds Dexter-style tools, Dexerto listing a knife, tape, rope and a syringe and TheGamer adding toolboxes and gloves.
Dexerto names the lookalike boat at the nearby dock as a Lure Predator L35P and says it can be stolen and taken out on the water.
TheGamer adds that players diving near the apartment have posted pictures of trash bags on the sea floor, like those Dexter uses in the show.

Disagreement: GameSpot, cited earlier in this entry, says it found no Dexter objects near the building; Dexerto and TheGamer, both drawing on footage from the DETONATED account, report the rooftop tools.
